string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: Heart-safety companion for Long QT syndrome

string.name: agent_placeholder
string.value: Chat with the agent about your condition, medicines and symptoms. Coming soon.

string.name: medicines_placeholder
string.value: Your medicines and QT-risk checks will appear here.

string.name: heart_placeholder
string.value: Live heart rate from your watch or a simulated source will appear here.

string.name: emergency_placeholder
string.value: Your emergency card and SOS actions will appear here.

string.name: onboarding_subtitle
string.value: Set up your heart profile. It takes a minute and stays on this phone.

string.name: disclaimer
string.value: Not a medical device. Always ask your doctor or pharmacist.

string.name: error_generic
string.value: Something went wrong. Please try again.

string.name: verdict_copied
string.value: Question copied — paste it to your doctor or pharmacist.

string.name: verdict_dont_stop
string.value: Never stop a prescribed medicine on your own — talk to your doctor first.

string.name: check_ask_prompt
string.value: I was offered %s. Is it safe for me, and what should I ask my doctor?

string.name: meds_not_recognised
string.value: Not recognised — we will treat it as unchecked

string.name: meds_dose_hint
string.value: Dose (optional), e.g. 5 mg in the morning

string.name: medicines_subtitle
string.value: Check before you take anything new

string.name: meds_empty
string.value: No medicines yet. Add one or scan a box.

string.name: meds_swipe_hint
string.value: Swipe left on a medicine to remove it.

string.name: history_empty
string.value: No checks yet. Check a medicine to see it here.

string.name: emergency_subtitle
string.value: Call for help and show your card

string.name: emergency_no_profile
string.value: Finish setup to see your emergency card.

string.name: emergency_card_copied
string.value: Card link copied — paste it in any browser or chat.

string.name: emergency_qr_hint
string.value: Scan with any phone camera to open this card in the reader's language. The card is inside the link — nothing is uploaded.

string.name: emergency_qr_hint_encrypted
string.value: Scan with any phone camera to open this card in the reader's language. The card was encrypted on this phone before upload; only this link can open it.

string.name: home_no_checks
string.value: Nothing checked yet. Before you take something new, check it here.

string.name: onb_contact_invalid
string.value: Enter a name and a valid phone number

string.name: onb_name_hint
string.value: Your name (shown on the emergency card)

string.name: onb_icd_hint
string.value: Shown on your emergency card for paramedics

string.name: onb_meds_subtitle
string.value: We check each medicine and warn you about interactions with new ones.

string.name: onb_contacts_subtitle
string.value: Emergency contacts appear on your card and get your SOS.

string.name: onb_finish_subtitle
string.value: Your country sets the emergency number we call.

string.name: onb_notes_hint
string.value: Notes for paramedics, e.g. allergies, cardiologist's phone

string.name: onb_privacy
string.value: Everything you enter stays on this phone.

string.name: settings_test_sos_hint
string.value: Practise the SOS flow — marked as TEST

string.name: settings_clear_confirm
string.value: This deletes your profile, medicines and history from this phone.

string.name: privacy_subtitle
string.value: App lock and every request the app sent

string.name: perm_location_reason
string.value: Your location is added to the SOS message so your contacts can find you.

string.name: sos_explain
string.value: If you don't answer, we prepare the SOS: call the ambulance and alert your contacts.

string.name: sos_sent_subtitle
string.value: Call the ambulance first, then send the message to your contacts.

string.name: sos_share
string.value: Send SOS message to my contacts

string.name: sos_no_location
string.value: Location unavailable — the message says so.

string.name: sos_sms_note
string.value: Your phone's share sheet sends the message (SMS, messenger or e-mail). Apps cannot send SMS silently on HarmonyOS.

string.name: lock_subtitle
string.value: Your medicines and history are protected. In an emergency, anyone can open the help guide.

string.name: by_title
string.value: This person has a heart condition

string.name: by_subtitle
string.value: Follow these steps. Stay calm — you are doing the right thing.

string.name: by_subtitle_generic
string.value: Follow these steps. Stay calm — you are doing the right thing.

string.name: by_step2_body
string.value: Push hard and fast in the centre of the chest, about 5 cm deep. Follow the beat below. Don't stop until help arrives.

string.name: by_step3_body
string.value: Send someone for the nearest defibrillator (AED). Switch it on and follow its voice.

string.name: by_cpr_start
string.value: Tap to start the CPR beat (110 per minute)

string.name: by_cpr_running
string.value: Push on every pulse. Tap to stop.

string.name: by_icd
string.value: Has an implanted defibrillator (ICD) — still do CPR; an AED is safe to use.

string.name: dp_intro
string.value: Pick who you are seeing. We prepare a safety brief from your own records.

string.name: dp_ai_caption
string.value: Generated summary of the brief below, not medical advice. The risk words in the brief come from the QT list, not from AI.

string.name: dp_ai_rejected
string.value: Couldn't write a summary that follows the safety rules. The brief below is complete.

string.name: dp_ai_failed
string.value: Couldn't reach the summary service. The brief below is complete and works offline.

string.name: privacy_promise
string.value: Your profile, medicines, contacts, heart data, history and chats with the agent are stored only on this phone, encrypted. Nothing is uploaded unless listed below.

string.name: privacy_lock_hint
string.value: Face, fingerprint or PIN when opening the app

string.name: sym_subtitle
string.value: Note how you felt — it goes into your doctor brief

string.name: sym_red_flag
string.value: This can be serious. If it is happening now, get help.

string.name: rem_empty
string.value: No reminders yet. Pick a medicine and a time below.

string.name: a11y_rem_row_hint
string.value: Long press to delete this reminder

string.name: rem_failed
string.value: Saved, but the system reminder could not be set

string.name: ph_subtitle
string.value: Show it at the pharmacy counter

string.name: scan_unknown_box
string.value: Couldn't read that box. Type the name instead?

string.name: privacy_lock_unavailable
string.value: Set a screen lock (PIN) on your phone first.

string.name: teach_body
string.value: We don't have this barcode yet (only Polish boxes are built in). Type the medicine name printed on the box and we will remember it for next time.

string.name: teach_name_hint
string.value: Name on the box, e.g. Analgin or Sumamed

string.name: teach_unrecognised
string.value: Not in our QT list — it will be checked as unknown

string.name: cardview_note
string.value: Scanned from a Celia QR code. Read on this phone only — nothing was saved.

string.name: mic_reason
string.value: The agent listens while you talk to it, so you can ask about medicines by voice.

string.name: agent_status
string.value: Your heart-safety agent · not a medical device

string.name: agent_offline
string.value: I'm offline, but medicine checks still work.

string.name: agent_welcome
string.value: Ask me about a medicine, scan a box, or tell me how you feel. Medicine verdicts always come from the QT-risk list, never from guesswork.

string.name: agent_starter_avoid
string.value: What should I avoid with my genotype?

string.name: agent_live_on
string.value: Live voice is on. Just talk.

string.name: agent_live_failed
string.value: Live voice isn't available right now. Tap the mic, speak, then tap again to send.

string.name: agent_mic_unavailable
string.value: I can't use the microphone. Allow it in Settings, or type instead.

string.name: verdict_source
string.value: CredibleMeds-derived list · Not a medical device. Always ask your doctor or pharmacist.

string.name: verdict_source_short
string.value: CredibleMeds-derived list · Not a medical device.

string.name: a11y_trace_expanded
string.value: Expanded. Double tap to hide the lookup steps.

string.name: a11y_trace_collapsed
string.value: Collapsed. Double tap to show the lookup steps.

string.name: scan_hint
string.value: Point the camera at the barcode on the box.

string.name: check_failed
string.value: Couldn't check that just now. Try again?

string.name: heart_only_hr
string.value: Heart rate only. This app does not measure QT.

string.name: a11y_hr_chart
string.value: Heart rate over the last minutes: between %d and %d beats per minute

string.name: checkin_note
string.value: If I don't hear back, I'll start the emergency countdown.

string.name: em_sos_sub
string.value: Alerts your contacts if you don't answer

string.name: em_bystander_sub
string.value: Step-by-step help for the person next to you

string.name: em_read_unavailable
string.value: No voice is available for this language right now. Show the card instead.

string.name: share_remove_body
string.value: Anyone who has the link or the QR will no longer be able to open your card. You can make a new link later.

string.name: agent_voice_idle_hint
string.value: Ask about a medicine, or tell me how you feel.

string.name: agent_voice_muted
string.value: Muted. Tap the mic to unmute.

string.name: agent_voice_unavailable
string.value: I can't use the microphone right now.

string.name: agent_alt_none
string.value: No verified alternatives on the list. Your doctor needs to choose one with you.

string.name: agent_alt_caveat
string.value: Not listed doesn't guarantee safety. Only a doctor can switch your medicine.

string.name: agent_card_sub
string.value: Show it to a bystander, paramedic or doctor

string.name: agent_scan_sub
string.value: I'll read the name and check it

string.name: agent_share_card_sub
string.value: You choose where it goes. Nothing is sent until you confirm.

string.name: widget_check_desc
string.value: Scan or type a medicine to check it against the QT list.

string.name: widget_alert_desc
string.value: Your condition, medicines and emergency call, readable by anyone.

string.name: chats_empty
string.value: No chats yet. Ask the agent something to start one.

string.name: chats_privacy
string.value: Chats are saved only on this phone.

string.name: chats_delete_body
string.value: The messages are removed from this phone. Your medicines and checks stay.

string.name: a11y_chats_row_hint
string.value: Long press to rename or delete

string.name: med_no_interactions
string.value: No known interactions with your other medicines on our list.

string.name: med_unknown_body
string.value: We couldn't match this name to our list, so we can't say anything about heart rhythm. Check the spelling or ask your pharmacist.

string.name: med_ai_caption
string.value: Generated explanation, not medical advice. The heart-rhythm badge above comes from the QT list, not from AI.

string.name: med_ai_offline
string.value: Explanations need a connection. Everything above works offline.

string.name: med_ai_unknown
string.value: No explanation found for this name. Check the spelling.

string.name: med_ai_rejected
string.value: Couldn't write a safe summary for this one. The facts above are complete.

string.name: med_ai_failed
string.value: Couldn't reach the explanation service. Try again later; everything above works offline.

string.name: med_source
string.value: Facts: public patient leaflets · QT data: CredibleMeds-derived list · Not a medical device.

string.name: rem_gentle
string.value: Gentle reminders, no sudden loud alarm. They work even when the app is closed.

string.name: share_card_caption
string.value: End-to-end encrypted. The link stays the same until your card changes.

string.name: share_removed
string.value: Link removed — it no longer opens

string.name: dp_link_caption
string.value: Opens on any phone or computer. Encrypted, and it stops working after 48 hours.

string.name: dp_link_failed
string.value: Couldn’t create the link. Check the connection, or share the text instead.

string.name: dp_link_message
string.value: My Long QT safety report (opens in any browser, link works for 48 hours):

string.name: med_ask_prompt
string.value: Tell me about %s: what is it for, and is it OK with my long QT and my other medicines?

string.name: scan_lookup_web_caption
string.value: This can take up to 20 seconds.

string.name: scan_candidate_ai_caption
string.value: Found by a web search. Check the name matches your box.

string.name: pair_row_unpaired
string.value: Not paired · using the shared demo watch

string.name: pair_intro
string.value: Link your watch so this phone shows only your heart data.

string.name: pair_step_1
string.value: On the watch, open Settings → Pair with phone.

string.name: pair_step_2
string.value: Type the 6-digit code it shows. The code works for 5 minutes.

string.name: pair_replaced
string.value: This watch was paired with another phone. Pair again to see its data here.

string.name: pair_err_code
string.value: That code didn't work. Check the watch and try again, or get a new code.

string.name: pair_err_rate
string.value: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then get a new code on the watch.

string.name: pair_err_offline
string.value: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

string.name: pair_err_backend
string.value: Pairing needs the online service, which isn't set up in this build.

string.name: checkin_answered_watch_ok
string.value: You answered on your watch: I'm OK

string.name: intake_body
string.value: Log it so your watch keeps a closer eye on your heart for the next 3 days. This doesn't mean it's safe for you.

string.name: intake_confirm_body
string.value: Your watch will lower its heart-rate limits for 3 days, and you'll be asked how you feel if your heart rate rises. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about this medicine today.

string.name: intake_watching
string.value: Your watch is watching more closely until %s.

string.name: intake_not_synced
string.value: Logged on this phone, but your watch couldn't be reached. Try again when you're online.

string.name: agent_open_brief_sub
string.value: Open the full brief for this visit

string.name: trends_subtitle
string.value: Resting heart rate, doses and symptoms by day

string.name: trends_not_ecg
string.value: Daily resting heart rate from the watch. This is not an ECG.

string.name: a11y_trend_chart
string.value: Resting heart rate per day. %d of %d days have a reading, between %d and %d beats per minute. A dose was logged on %d days and a symptom on %d days.

string.name: a11y_trend_chart_empty
string.value: Resting heart rate per day. No readings in the last %d days.

string.name: trends_offline
string.value: Couldn't load your watch history. Check your connection and open this page again.

string.name: trends_disclaimer
string.value: Shown to help you and your doctor see patterns. Not a diagnosis. Not a medical device.
